topics.name: Energy, flooding and other city questions

note: Estimates from outcome city_effect; bands and thresholds read from the registration's prediction in city_effect units; placebos and referee values from critique/*.md and the outcome notes. Built by tools/build_annotations.py, which checks each hand-copied number against its source text.

afford-gentrification-prevalence.label: share of the 22 lowest-rent areas of 2000 whose rent and college share both grew faster than the city's by 2022-2024

afford-poor-count-shift.label: difference in mean log change of the number of poor residents, 2000 to 2022-2024, gentrified minus other low-rent areas

all-boats-trees-rent.label: 2020 census tracts (n=2,048): change in log median gross rent, ACS 2008-12 to 2018-22, per 100 additional living street trees between the 2005 and 2015 censuses; OLS with baseline trees per km2, log rent, white share, log density and borough; SE clustered by NTA

bridge-crz-crash-link.text: A research link (speed and volume elasticities from the literature); city data test it only through the bridge's endpoint.

bridge-crz-ems-travel.label: EMS mean travel time, zone vs all other city ZIPs, peak toll hours, 5 Jan-31 Aug 2025 vs 2023-24 (DiD on monthly log means, HAC 3)

bridge-crz-injury-crashes-v2.label: Endpoint: NYPD injury crashes in the CBD geofence vs Manhattan north of 60th St, 2025 vs 2022-24 (OLS log monthly count, HAC 3)

bridge-crz-injury-crashes.label: Endpoint: NYPD injury crashes in the CBD geofence vs rest of city, 2025 vs 2022-24 (OLS log monthly count, HAC 3)

bridge-heat-shootings-ems.label: Endpoint: daily FDNY EMS SHOT dispatches, Central Park TMAX lag 0, NB GLM as heat-shootings, 2006 to Aug 2026

bridge-shot-ems-link.label: Daily EMS SHOT dispatches per NYPD shooting incident, same day (OLS with day of week, month, year, holiday; HAC 7)

commute-fhv-subway-distance.label: elasticity of 2024 HVFHV pickups per resident with respect to distance to nearest station, adjusted for income and jobs

commute-time-depression.label: age-adjusted adult depression, percentage points per 5 min of mean commute, adjusted for poverty and subway access

construction-2022-rush-units-2027.text: Registered for a date not yet reached (30 June 2027); no outcome yet.

construction-aerial-triangulation.label: share of 48 sampled NB jobs (first permit 2018-2020) with visible change of the lot, NAIP 2017 to 2022

construction-four-year-completion.label: share of NB jobs with a first CO within 4 years of first NB permit, pooled cohorts 2010-2017 (registered statistic)
construction-four-year-completion.unit_full: proportion; null set to the registered support threshold 0.75

construction-permit-funnel.label: legacy NB permit rows per distinct NB job, rows issued 2010-2019
construction-permit-funnel.unit_full: rows per job (null: 1 row per building)

construction-sheds-outnumber-nb.label: ratio of jobs with an active sidewalk-shed permit to jobs with an active NB work permit, 1 Nov 2026
construction-sheds-outnumber-nb.unit_full: ratio (interval spans the two definitions of active, not sampling error)

construction2-rows-per-job-dobnow.label: DOB NOW work-permit rows per NB job by Nov 2026, jobs first permitted 2021-2022
construction2-rows-per-job-dobnow.unit_full: rows per job (null: 1 row per building)

construction2-rows-per-job-legacy-2000s.label: legacy NB permit rows per job over the table's life, jobs first permitted 2000-2009
construction2-rows-per-job-legacy-2000s.unit_full: rows per job (null: 1 row per building)

crz-storefront-vacancy.label: Change in storefront vacancy share, 31 Dec 2025 vs 31 Dec 2024, zone minus all other city ZIPs (bootstrap over tax lots)

ems-hospital-turnaround-wait.label: Elasticity of daily mean wait for an ambulance assignment (all calls) to daily mean time at hospital of transported patients, holding log call count, weekday and year-month; NYC, 2017-01-02 to 2026-09-30 excluding Mar-Jun 2020; OLS, HAC 7 lags

ems-taxi-2026-onset.label: slope of weekly year-on-year change in Manhattan EMS travel time on that of taxi time per mile, 2025-W27 to 2026-W39

ems-traffic-hourly-elasticity.label: elasticity of Manhattan EMS mean travel time to same-hour yellow-taxi time per mile, joint model with the 7-day lead, within date x area

ems-traffic-share-2019-2026.label: share of the 2019-2026 rise in Manhattan life-threatening EMS travel time that traffic could account for if ambulance pace moved one for one with taxi pace (S1)

food-supermarket-diabetes-zcta.label: Diabetes admissions (SPARCS PQI 01, 03, 14, 16, observed/expected, 2021-2023) per doubling of supermarkets >= 6,000 sq ft per 10,000 residents, adjusted for log residential density, poverty, log income and median age; 168 NYC ZCTAs, WLS by population, HC3

further-chinatown-shift.label: Change in non-Hispanic Asian+Pacific Islander residents, 23-tract Chinatown set B1, 2010 census to ACS 2018-22 (primary reading D1, M1); interval is the ACS 90% margin of error applied to the 2020 count

further-containers-rats-cd9.label: CD9 relative to CD7/10/11/12, 311 Rat Sighting counts, Jun 2025-May 2026 vs Jun 2024-May 2025

further-datacentre-share-manhattan-v2.label: High figure for data-centre share of Manhattan LL84 grid electricity, CY2024, minus 4.4 percent

further-datacentre-share-manhattan.label: Upper-bound data-centre share of Manhattan LL84 grid electricity, CY2024, minus 4.4 percent

further-repro-dsny-rat-sightings.label: Recomputed Dec 2024-Nov 2025 vs Dec 2023-Nov 2024 311 Rat Sightings under R1, percent change

further-subway-crime-per-million-repro.label: MTA Major Felonies (yeek-jhmu, NYCT, Jan-Nov 2025) rate per million riders divided by the State's 1.65

further-subway-crime-per-ride-by-hour.label: late-night (0-5) subway felony rate per million entries, Oct 2025-Sep 2026 against 2019

further-tidal-flooding-311.label: Tidal-set rate ratio of street-flooding complaints, Battery minor-flood day vs other rain-free days (not decisive: minimum-data rule failed)
further-tidal-flooding-311.text: The registered minimum-data rule failed, so the rate ratio decides nothing.

further-tidal-flooding-trend.label: Rate ratio of dry-day street-flooding and catch-basin complaints in the coastal ZIP set per 10 cm of Battery daily maximum above 0.35 m over MHHW, 2010-2019 held-out period
further-tidal-flooding-trend.unit: rate ratio per 10 cm above knot
further-tidal-flooding-trend.unit_full: rate ratio per 10 cm above knot

further-zonej-demand-growth.label: Zone J weather-normalised annual energy trend, 2015-2025, pandemic days 2020-03-15 to 2021-06-30 excluded
further-zonej-demand-growth.unit_full: percent a year (OLS on daily ln energy, Newey-West 14 lags, 95% interval)

graph-concordance-matrix.label: Share of 109 qualifying indicator pairs whose poverty-partialled Spearman correlation across 42 UHF neighbourhoods has the literature's majority sign (interval: bootstrap of neighbourhoods)

graph-confounders-commute-obesity.label: Adult obesity per 10 points of walk-or-bike commute share, 42 UHF neighbourhoods, adjusted for the graph-derived set (poverty, high-school graduation, percent Black, Hispanic and Asian, walkability, perceived safety), OLS, HC3
graph-confounders-commute-obesity.unit: percentage points of obesity per 10 points of active commuting
graph-confounders-commute-obesity.unit_full: percentage points of obesity per 10 points of active commuting

graph-confounders-surftemp-ed.label: Change in the percent change of the heat-stress ED rate per 1 F of surface temperature when the share of older adults living alone is added to poverty, percent Black and AC; community districts; paired bootstrap interval

graph-confounders-trees-surftemp.label: Change in the slope of surface temperature on z(log street trees per km2) when log population density, building footprint share and road share are added to poverty and percent Black; community districts; paired bootstrap interval; population density corrected for the four PUMAs that each cover two districts

graph-triad-cold-asthma-absence.label: citywide absence rate on cold school days against other school days of the same week of the year

graph-triad-hot-asthma-absence.label: citywide absence rate on hot school days against other school days of the same week of the year

placebo.label: referee placebo: heat two days later

heat-ac-heat-calls.label: Difference between the log rate ratios of EMS HEAT calls per 5 C of TMAX, low-AC half minus high-AC half of community districts, May-September 2006-2026
heat-ac-heat-calls.unit: difference of log rate ratios per 5 C
heat-ac-heat-calls.unit_full: difference of log rate ratios per 5 C

heat-ac-shootings.label: Difference between the log rate ratios of shootings per 5 C of TMAX, low-AC half minus high-AC half of community districts, 2006-2026
heat-ac-shootings.unit: difference of log rate ratios per 5 C
heat-ac-shootings.unit_full: difference of log rate ratios per 5 C

heat-ed-syndromic.label: NYC syndromic heat ED visits per day, May-Sep 2017-2026, Central Park TMAX lag 0, NB GLM with DOW, month, year, holiday

heat-extremes-downturn.label: Aggravated assaults, days at 38 C or more against days at 32 to 35 C, pooled over Phoenix, Tucson, Dallas and Austin

heat-mech-intox.label: Attenuation of the heat-shootings slope by daily EMS drug and alcohol dispatches, 2006-2026
heat-mech-intox.unit: share of the log IRR of shootings per 5 C removed by adding the proxy
heat-mech-intox.unit_full: share of the log IRR of shootings per 5 C removed by adding the proxy

heat-mech-outdoors.label: Attenuation of the heat-shootings slope by daily 311 Noise - Street/Sidewalk complaints, 2010-2026
heat-mech-outdoors.unit: share of the log IRR of shootings per 5 C removed by adding the proxy
heat-mech-outdoors.unit_full: share of the log IRR of shootings per 5 C removed by adding the proxy

heat-night-minimum.label: New York shooting incidents per 5 C of the preceding night's minimum (Central Park TMIN) at fixed TMAX, shooting days with TMAX >= 27 C, 2006-2026

heat-school-out.label: Rate ratio of shooting incidents, weekdays out of school against school weekdays at the same temperature, within 42 days of the last or first day of classes, 2006-2026

heat-shootings.label: NYC shooting incidents per day, Central Park TMAX lag 0, NB GLM with DOW, month, year, holiday, rain

heat-surftemp-ed.label: Area-level (community district) association, contradicting the registrant's bridge link: Log age-adjusted heat-stress ED rate (EHDP 2443, 5-year) on surface temperature, CD, adjusted for poverty, percent Black, AC

heat-trees-airtemp-hyperlocal.label: Sensor afternoon (12-18h) air temperature on live street trees within 50 m, NTA-by-day fixed effects, install type, SE clustered by sensor

heat-trees-canopy-within-nta.label: Sensor afternoon (12-18 h) air temperature on vegetation share (NAIP 2022, NDVI > 0.2) within 50 m; NTA by flight date by day fixed effects, light-pole indicator, SE clustered by sensor
heat-trees-canopy-within-nta.unit: C per 10 percentage points of vegetation share
heat-trees-canopy-within-nta.unit_full: C per 10 percentage points of vegetation share

placebo.label: placebo: vegetation share of the ring 200-300 m from the sensor

heat-trees-ed-chain.label: Composed a*b, trees -> surface temperature -> log heat ED rate, CD, bootstrap 5000

heat-trees-surftemp.label: Surface temperature (Landsat 17 Jul 2018) on z(log live street trees per km2), CD, adjusted for poverty and percent Black

levers-vacant-lot-trial-match.label: Share of land use 11 lots in the top-decile shooting tracts that resemble the Philadelphia trial lots
levers-vacant-lot-trial-match.unit_full: share of lots (a count, no sampling interval: every lot was classified)

mob-active-commute-obesity.label: Adult obesity (percentage points) per 10 points of walk-or-bike commute share, poverty-adjusted, 42 UHF neighbourhoods
mob-active-commute-obesity.unit: percentage points of obesity per 10 points of active commuting
mob-active-commute-obesity.unit_full: percentage points of obesity per 10 points of active commuting

mob-asthma-pollution.label: Asthma ED visits age 5-17 per 10 ppb NO2, poverty-adjusted, 42 UHF neighbourhoods, 2017-19

mob-crz-air-nyccas.label: NYCCAS annual NO2, UHF 306-310 vs 32 UHFs outside Manhattan, 2025 vs 2021-24 (DiD); interval from placebo-in-space

mob-crz-air.label: PM2.5 at PS 19 (only in-zone AQS monitor with a pre-period) vs other-borough monitors, 2025 vs 2023-24, TWFE DiD
mob-crz-air.text: No Manhattan NO2 monitor reported to EPA in 2022-2025, so the registered test could not be run.

mob-crz-traffic.label: CBD vs rest-of-city taxi/FHV speed, 2025 vs 2023-24 (DiD)

mob-speedcam-247.label: Injury crashes, new hours vs old hours, Aug 2022-Jul 2023 vs Aug 2021-Jul 2022 (ratio of ratios), citywide

nbhd-noise311-exposure.label: 2020 tracts: beta(rent change) - beta(modelled transport noise) in OLS of log(1 + residential noise complaints per 1,000 residents per year, 2022-2024), per SD, borough effects; tract bootstrap 95% CI
nbhd-noise311-exposure.unit: difference in log units per SD
nbhd-noise311-exposure.unit_full: difference in log units per SD

nbhd-rodents-asthma.label: UHF42 (n=42): change in log asthma ED rate age 5-17 (2017) per SD of % homes with mice or rats in the building (NYCHVS 2017), adjusted for poverty % (2013-17) and renter housing problems % (2017); OLS, HC3

nbhd-vacant-shootings.label: NYC 2020 tracts: shootings 2019-2024 per resident, IRR per quintile step of vacant-land share, adjusted for poverty, log density, borough (negative binomial, HC1 SE)

repro-dcp-2025-completions.label: relative difference, R1 (sum of classaprop, New Building, compltyear 2025, 26Q2.1) minus DCP's 38,682, as a share of 38,682; interval is +/- the 0.34% revision DCP made to 2024 between releases, not a sampling interval

repro-dot-2025-deaths.label: 2025 traffic deaths, NYPD open data (persons table, crash date in 2025) minus DOT's 205, percent

repro-mmr-cbd-speed.label: R1 reproduced FY26 speed minus MMR stated FY26 speed (6.5 mph); lo and hi are the range of this difference over the readings that reproduce both years (R1, R3, R7, R8, R9)

restaurants-nta-harshness.label: Between-NTA SD of the adjusted log rate ratio of critical violations per routine initial inspection (tau, method of moments)

restaurants-score-complaints.label: IRR of 311 Food Poisoning complaints at the lot in the 365 days after a routine initial inspection, score >= 14 against 0-13

retimed-daytime-burglary.label: Ratio of the Monday-and-Friday to Tuesday-to-Thursday ratio of daytime residential burglaries, 2023 to September 2026 over 2015-2019, citywide

retimed-ems-presence.label: Elasticity of daytime EMS incidents to subway entries: the business-district-minus-rest change in the Monday-and-Friday ratio of incidents, divided by the same difference for entries (-0.0639)

retimed-taxi-fhv-pickups.label: Slope of the change in Monday-and-Friday relative pickups on the change in Monday-and-Friday relative subway entries, across taxi zones, Feb-Mar 2019 to Feb-Mar 2026

rlc-expansion-injuries.label: Persons injured or killed within 50 m, camera intersections vs matched controls, post vs same months of 2024-25 (ratio of ratios)

rlc-expansion-rearend.label: Rear-end proxy crashes within 50 m, camera intersections vs matched controls, post vs same months of 2024-25 (ratio of ratios)

sim-crz-holdout-2026.label: S1: held-out elasticity of zone taxi speed to vehicle entries as a ratio of the elasticity fitted on 2025 (-0.409); non-holiday weekdays 5 January to 30 June 2026, by band of hours. The estimate is fixed by two storm days (23 February and 26 January 2026), which carry 84% of the identifying variation; without them S1 is -0.23 with a standard error of 1.05
sim-crz-holdout-2026.unit: ratio of held-out to fitted elasticity
sim-crz-holdout-2026.unit_full: ratio of held-out to fitted elasticity

split-temp-asthma-ems.label: Asthma EMS dispatches, October to March, per 5 C higher mean temperature over lags 0-3 days

split-temp-covid-growth.label: Weekly log growth of COVID-19 hospital admissions per 1 C temperature anomaly, days 7-20 before
split-temp-covid-growth.unit: change in weekly log growth per +1 C
split-temp-covid-growth.unit_full: change in weekly log growth per +1 C

stalled-421a-vesting-footings.label: D1: 36-month no-CO rate, foundation starts 15 Dec 2021-14 Jun 2022 minus same window 2017-2019 (registered BBL matching)

stalled-flood-zone-starts.label: borough-stratified (Mantel-Haenszel) risk difference in the 36-month no-CO rate, flood minus non-flood

street-busway14-crosstown-detour.label: Weekday crosstown taxi metered distance, 14th Street pairs minus control pairs

street-busway14-crosstown-time.label: Weekday crosstown taxi trip duration, 14th Street pairs minus control pairs

street-busway14-fhv-north-south.label: FHV weekday trip duration, north pairs (East Chelsea to Stuy Town/Gramercy) minus controls, seasonal swing net of yellow-taxi swing

street-busway14-m14-speed.label: M14A+M14D weekday speed, Oct 2019-Feb 2020 against Jul-Sep 2019, relative to other Manhattan routes

street-busway14-ped-injuries.label: Pedestrian-injury crashes on 14th St (9th-3rd Av) relative to 23rd, 34th, 42nd, 57th St; Oct 2019-Sep 2022 against Oct 2014-Sep 2019

transfer-chicago-concordance-matrix.label: Share of the 15 qualifying pairs of PM2.5, ozone or traffic with a health outcome whose poverty-partialled Spearman correlation across 77 Chicago community areas has the literature's sign (interval: bootstrap of areas); the null is New York's 10 of 27

transfer-chicago-heat-shootings.label: Chicago daily gunshot-injury cases (gumc-mgzr), Midway TMAX lag 0, NB GLM with DOW, month, year, holiday, rain

transfer-chicago-hot-end.label: Chicago gunshot-injury cases, ratio 33 C against 27 C of Midway TMAX (piecewise-linear spline), 2010-2026

transfer-chicago-weekday-pattern.label: Change in the Monday/Friday deficit of Chicago Loop 'L' entries, Sep 2025-Aug 2026 minus 2019
transfer-chicago-weekday-pattern.unit: percentage points of the Tue-Thu mean
transfer-chicago-weekday-pattern.unit_full: percentage points of the Tue-Thu mean

transit-fhv-price-subway.label: Weekday subway entries south of 96th St vs outside, 8 weeks after 2 Feb 2019 vs 3 weeks before, less the same in 2018 (not decisive: the registered first-stage gate failed)
transit-fhv-price-subway.text: The registered first-stage gate failed, so the subway estimate decides nothing.

transit-gtrain-substitution.label: change in daily Uber and Lyft pickups in seven taxi zones on days when their G-only station had no service, against 32 nearby zones (zone and date fixed effects)

transit-weekday-pattern.label: Change in the Monday/Friday deficit of CBD subway entries, Nov 2025-Oct 2026 minus 2019
transit-weekday-pattern.unit: percentage points of the Tue-Thu mean
transit-weekday-pattern.unit_full: percentage points of the Tue-Thu mean

turn-calming-displacement.label: Pedestrians injured or killed 50-200 m from the site (excluding crashes within 40 m of any calming site), treated vs later-treated

turn-calming-leftturn.label: Crashes with a vehicle 'Making Left Turn' within 40 m, 24 months after vs before, treated vs later-treated calming sites

turn-calming-ped.label: Pedestrians injured or killed within 40 m, 24 months after vs 24 months before installation, treated vs later-treated calming sites, stacked cohorts 2016Q3-2023Q2
